system.description: You give the fear of the dark a body, and it rolls across a 30' cone.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and Strong foes roll Morale too.
outcomes.success: Every creature in the cone takes d12 damage. Each foe of Moderate tier or lower rolls Morale; a demoralised foe flees for d4 rounds (rather than surrendering) and drops whatever it carries. Mindless foes take an additional d12 damage instead.
outcomes.failure: Half damage, and no one rolls Morale.
outcomes.ruin: The dark looks back: test Sanity DR12 or Panic. Roll on the Shadowblight table.

outcomeEffects.note: each foe of Moderate tier or lower (Strong too on a Triumph) rolls Morale; a demoralised foe flees for d4 rounds and drops what it carries; mindless foes take +d12 instead
